dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your explanation was very good, Ms. Elphane.

dialogues.speaker: Elphane
dialogues.text: P—Please refrain from jokes in such poor taste, dear passenger!

dialogues.speaker: Elphane
dialogues.text: *cough* If you like listening to explanations, I personally recommend that you ride the Clementine Line, on which Aeval serves as a guide.
